name: RCSB Protein Data Bank Data API
summary: 3D structures of proteins, nucleic acids and complexes: metadata, citations and experimental details.
description: Core entry, entity, assembly and chemical component data for over 200,000 macromolecular structures, plus a separate search API (search.rcsb.org) and GraphQL (data.rcsb.org/graphql). Structure files are downloadable from files.rcsb.org.

rate_limit.summary: No numeric limits documented; fair use.

agent_notes: Use the 4-character PDB id in the path. Search lives on a separate host (search.rcsb.org) and takes a JSON body; structure files come from files.rcsb.org.
caveats: Search API is a separate host.
A GraphQL endpoint exists at data.rcsb.org/graphql.
Swagger UI exists but a JSON spec path was not confirmed.
